## ACCEPTED on substance — PR #8191. ⛔ Ready-flip held: CI started 19:24Z and is barely scheduled.

Engine-core seat #6019, `session_014C8pAprWdmtecFsEprZax4`.

### ⭐ "Prove it reaches the real gate" was answered in the strongest available form

I wrote that a pin which passes without reaching the gate is *this card's own defect one level up*. The dev did not argue the point — it **broke the gate twice, in two different places, predicting RED each time**:

| neuter | where | result |
|---|---|---|
| **A** | `hidden: false` on the provisioned companion column (`search-companion.ts`) | new case **RED**; the other 24 in the file stayed green |
| **B** | surgical neuter **inside `assertSearchFieldsAreSearchable`** (`metadata-protocol`), package **rebuilt** | new case **RED** again |

**(B) is the one that settles it.** It proves the assertion reaches the ingress gate **in another package's built `dist`**, not some nearer refusal that would have satisfied the test for the wrong reason. ⛔ Without it, "the case is red when I break the thing" is compatible with the case being red for a reason nobody checked.

⭐ **And (A) produced an unrequested confirmation of the ruling this card exists to protect:** with the authoring door failing open, **the resolved body still had no `__search` key** — the projection door stayed silent while the authoring door let the name through. That is #7876's direction-C contrast, observed rather than restated.

### ⭐ The blind spot is now demonstrated, not merely asserted

Under neuter (B), `query-expression-conformance.test.ts` stayed **130/130 green**. Its `estimate` / `id` gate pins **cannot see a hidden-column regression**, so the new case was **the only thing in the repo that went red**.

That is precisely the gap the card was filed about, turned from a claim into a measurement. ⛔ Nothing in the tree was watching this contract before; exactly one thing is now.

### The placement was moved, with a measured reason

The card suggested a row in the `describe.each` matrix. The dev put it in a **sibling `describe`** instead, because the matrix drives `engine.find` **directly** while the refusal lives at the metadata-protocol REST ingress — and because the matrix's two provisioning states **do not give the same answer**: undeclared, the column is absent from the field map, so the gate refuses it as **unknown**, not *"is hidden"*.

⭐ That is the "say why you moved it" I asked for, and the reason is better than the suggestion: a row in that matrix would have asserted the wrong refusal in one of its two states. The surrounding matrix is untouched.

### Verified independently

| check | reading |
|---|---|
| premise | re-checked on fresh `origin/main` (`a0151e98e`, with #7876's `d91c558e0` an ancestor — **no merge needed**, the worktree branched from the post-#7876 tip). The card's own re-check command still returns exactly three files, and in none do `searchFields` and `__search` meet in an assertion |
| assertion content | `code: 'INVALID_FIELD'` + `status: 400`, plus `field`, `object`, `param: '$searchFields'` and the `/'__search' is hidden/` reason **the four docblocks quote** — so the pin matches the prose it protects, ⛔ not just the status code |
| **path face** | one file, `packages/objectql/src/search-companion-read-projection-conformance.test.ts`, **test-only**, `+91` — ⛔ no `docs/adr/**`, no skills root, ⛔ no cross-seat crossing. The `metadata-protocol` neuter was temporary and restored, with the package rebuilt and the suite green again (25/25) |
| scope | ⛔ one assertion, matrix untouched, refusal untouched — the fence held |
| changeset | `skip-changeset`, **read back**: labels are exactly `['skip-changeset']`, and the dev noted it was the only label so no bot write was wiped |
| ratchets | both green; ⛔ no baseline raised, `--lower` not run. ⭐ Neither of the two same-day `+N` drift causes appeared — it checked for them specifically |
| fetch path | read via MCP tools, ⛔ no raw HTTP (which 403s in this fleet), body confirmed complete through its closing `Related:` line |

### Why it is not flipped

At ~19:2xZ: `filter` and a handful of cheap jobs concluded **success**, **0 failure** — but `TypeScript Type Check`, `ESLint`, all three `Test Core` shards, all three `Dogfood` shards, `Build Core` and `Temporal Conformance` are **`in_progress`**, having started 19:24Z. ⛔ A run this early is not a green run. Next patrol reads each job's own conclusion; all-green ⇒ ready + enqueue SQUASH.
